messages:
maria-ml: FYI CI perf job `api-stream-latency-smoke` spiked on main after the last release, +35ms p50 on streaming endpoints. failing job: https://ci.internal/12345

kai-runtime: ugh, I noticed higher tail for SSE paths too in canaries. saw more small writes in trace.

anil-sre: deploy-bot flagged 2 canaries as degraded at 11:14 UTC :rotating_light: rollback flag set to false (manual hold). logs attached in the job.

lisa-product: did we change anything in toolcall serialization or SSE framing in that release? customers are pinging.

kai-runtime: there was a small refactor in PR #4567 that switched toolcall payload framing to the new compact-encode path to reduce memory copies. it also switched to emitting a length-prefixed header per sub-frame. thought it'd be noop for streaming.

maria-ml: bisect started. first candidate merges: 1) PR 4567 (framing/serialize change), 2) PR 4590 (kv-cache prefetch tweak).

kai-runtime: quick local repro with the canary build shows many 64B writes on the SSE connection (writev per chunk). strace snippet: 
```
writev(3, [{iov_base="\x1e\x00...", iov_len=64}, {iov_base="payload", iov_len=128}], 2) = 192
writev(3, [{iov_base="\x00\x00", iov_len=16}], 1) = 16
```
looks like we emit header frames more often now.

anil-sre: profiled the canary with `perf record -g` and `perf report` — syscalls for `writev` and `send` increased. CPU in runtime stayed flat, but syscall overhead and kernel scheduling increased latency.

maria-ml: interesting — kernel-autoselect didn't change for those canaries, so likely not kernel selection. more like framing -> small write pathology + Nagle/TCP overhead.

lisa-product: we should either revert the compact-encode framing or coalesce flushes asap. which is faster to ship?

kai-runtime: fastest is revert of the framing commit (PR 4567 revert). I prepared a revert branch locally. coalescing fix needs a bit of work to avoid changing semantics for toolcall progress.

maria-ml: do the bisect: can you confirm CI job on revert branch? if it fixes, hold rollout and merge revert.

kai-runtime: kicked off `api-stream-latency-smoke` against revert branch. job id: 12347.

deploy-bot: CI job 12347 queued -> running -> finished. status: SUCCESS. p50 delta vs main: -32ms on streaming endpoints.

anil-sre: great — revert fixes it. I recommend a hot-revert and patch in follow-up that coalesces sub-frames into a single writev so we can keep the compact-encode benefits without the syscall storm.

lisa-product: hold the rollout, merge revert, notify customer success. I'll prepare a brief for support. :thumbsup: 

maria-ml: created issue tracking follow-up: "streaming: coalesce toolcall sub-frames to avoid syscall latency" with perf traces and strace attached. assigning to kai.

kai-runtime: grabbing it. plan: add a per-request write buffer for SSE that accumulates up to 4KB or flush on final chunk, and preserve progress events with a single writev. should avoid Nagle interaction and reduce syscall count.

anil-sre: also adding a regression test to CI that validates p50/p95 for streaming smoke after changes, and a perf job gated on PRs touching framing.

maria-ml: thanks everyone. action items: merge revert PR (kai), notify on-call to keep an eye on canaries (anil), add CI perf gate (anil), follow-up coalescing PR (kai).

kai-runtime: pushed revert PR #4610. requesting reviewers. merging after approvals to un-block rollout.

lisa-product: posting update to #customer-facing with short blurb and ETA for fix.

maria-ml: closing loop: canary latency back to baseline after revert. leaving issue open for the robust coalesce approach. :white_check_mark:
